text: Android: one invalid field wedges sync forever, and sync failures are invisible
relates: T-28/T-31 for the 401 handling path only; the validation wedge itself is independent.

Quarantine (part 3) needs a NEW sync-state column: dirty:Boolean is the only
sync bit on ItemEntity/ListEntity, so "clear dirty to stop pushing the bad row"
silently discards the user's edit. Add a separate flag (e.g. syncBlocked) so
dirtyRows() skips it while the row stays visible/editable — a Room schema
change, but a destructive migration is fine here since all local data is
re-syncable (SyncEngine already does full wipe+resync on 410). Scoping for part
(1): of the fields the server 422-validates (status enum, decimal amount,
name-non-empty), the client already enforces name-non-empty and status is
UI-constrained — price amount + currency are the only user-typed fields with no
client validation, so input validation alone closes the practical wedge; the
row-id-in-422 + client quarantine is true defense-in-depth for the general case.
